title: Encoded invariant at startup
statement: For every finite binary string $x$, the encoded word of the startup seam state selected from $x$ is the canonical encoding of a state whose consumed length is at most $|x|$ and whose fresh-variable cursor is at most $|x|$ plus its consumed length.
replaced:
For every input string $x$, the encoded startup seam word of $x$ satisfies the
encoded loop invariant.
